title: Gravity based Storage Provider Energy Vault, Eskom Partner On 25 MW/100 MWh Project In South Africa
summary: Energy Vault and Eskom are partnering to develop a 25 MW/100 MWh gravity-based energy storage project in South Africa, aiming for 4 GWh of sustainable energy solutions.
body_markdown: ## The partnership intends to license, co‑develop, and collaborate on the deployment of up to 4 GWh of GESS storage. Energy Vault’s EVx 2.0™ GESS platform incorporates advancements over the previous EVx design.
